summary: Environment A direct-binary proof that Phase 15 (transcript stall visibility + fuller-context Bible detection) compiled into the real Windows NSIS installer: finalize_bible_fuller_context_retry, retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context, and persist_detections_and_suggestions are all present in the shipped exe, with zero regression against every prior phase's symbol tripwires.
gitCommitNote: This is the source tree commit (Phase 15's own core-implementation commit) the Phase 15 rebuild was performed against.

installer.ggmlTwoPassFixNote: First build attempt failed as expected on the known whisper-rs-sys ggml lib-name defect; the build script applied its established fix and the retry succeeded - the same harmless, unrelated build-toolchain quirk documented and handled identically in every prior whisper-enabled Windows rebuild this project has done (now a 9th consecutive rebuild).

symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings cip-desktop.exe | grep -c <symbol>, run against the extracted installer's main executable
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresResult: All 10 counts identical to the Phase 14 baseline - zero regression. whisper_full_with_state stable at 96 for a 9th consecutive rebuild (Phase 7.3 through Phase 15).
symbolRegressionCheck.priorPhaseNote: Every prior-phase symbol checked (Production Integration through Phase 14's whisper hallucination filtering) remains present and unregressed.

newSymbolsNote: finalize_bible_fuller_context_retry, retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context, and persist_detections_and_suggestions - the three new named functions this phase adds - are all directly present. window_had_suggestion is a local bool owned by spawn_speech_worker's thread closure, not a named function, and was inlined/elided by the release-mode optimizer as expected - consistent with this project's own established precedent for small local state (e.g. Phase 3.8.7.3's classify_overload/chunk_duration_ms).
frontendTextSearchLimitation: The frontend bundle is bundled into the Tauri resources directory, not searchable as plain strings inside cip-desktop.exe in the same way Rust symbols are - the new stall-indicator copy ('No new transcript in Ns...') was not found via strings (confirmed absent, as expected) and was not independently string-searched further, consistent with every prior phase's methodology. Frontend correctness for this phase rests on npm run typecheck's success, the fresh Vite build hash, and the full 294/294 frontend test pass (unchanged, since this UI change only displays an already-tested value).
architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events, zero new migrations - this phase lives entirely inside the existing Bible detection and transcript pipeline plus one frontend display change.
retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context can never attempt citation detection or mutate the active Scripture context.

Every prior-phase command (test_obs_connection, ensure_admin, operator_accounts, enable_congregant_companion, companion_snapshot, get_speech_language_capabilities, set_speech_language, get_church_knowledge_base, and Phase 14's own non-speech-placeholder handling) remains present and unregressed, confirming this phase's additions did not disturb any prior gate or feature.
environmentCStatus: Not yet performed. A second real pilot session on the same or similar Windows hardware, confirming the Live Transcript panel now surfaces a clear 'no new transcript' message instead of silently freezing during a long quiet/unclear stretch, and that a genuine paraphrase spoken without a book name is now more likely to be caught, is required to close Environment C for this phase, exactly as for every prior phase's physicalHardwareStatement discipline.
